title: AER Deterministic Fraud Proof Schema
description: Cryptographically signed objective assertion proving reproducible defect or contract violation to halt optimistic timelock release (AER Section 4.4.3).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

task_id.description: Target task escrow identifier being disputed.

reporter_node_id.description: Ethereum address of the challenger, client, or watchtower submitting the proof.

worker_node_id.description: Ethereum address of the worker node accused of submitting defective output.

source_artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the defective code, binary, or trajectory file.

error_code.description: Standardized compiler or validator error code (e.g. WASM_TRAP_UNREACHABLE, AST_PARSE_FAILURE).

reproduction_trace.description: Deterministic instruction step, line number, or stack trace reproducing the crash.

evaluator_version.description: Designated reference execution engine (e.g. wasmtime-21.0.0, cpython-3.12-ast).

deterministic_evaluator_digest.description: Cryptographic hash of the canonical evaluator engine or WebAssembly referee binary.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds when the proof was compiled.

reporter_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA signature generated by the reporter authorizing the dispute.
